en.headline: Education Bureau steps in after rain queues for school uniform checks
en.dek: Officials reminded two schools to consider students’ needs after first-day inspections left pupils waiting outside in the rain or kept on campus over hair rules.
body: The Education Bureau said it had contacted two schools after complaints that first-day uniform and hair inspections left students waiting in poor weather or kept on campus until parents were reached.

Social-media posts showed a long queue outside Kowloon Tong School (Secondary Section) on Tuesday, the first day of the new school year, with pupils waiting for teachers to check uniforms and hair while rain associated with the Standby Signal was falling. Principal Teresa Hon later wrote to parents that the school had reminded families on Saturday of a Tuesday inspection ahead of student photographs, and that a larger-than-usual number of late arrivals had led to queuing outside. She said students who tapped in after 8am that day would not be marked late, and that the school had reviewed how the checks were carried out.

Separately, readers told local media that about 300 students at Tang King Po School in Ho Man Tin were kept at school for close to an hour because their hair was judged too long, with staff required to telephone parents before they could leave.

An Education Bureau spokesman said the bureau had immediately contacted the schools to follow up, and reminded them that when drawing up and enforcing school rules they should also take account of students’ actual needs and make appropriate school-based arrangements. The bureau said it already issues general guidance on school rules.

zh.headline: 開學日冒雨查儀容 教育局提醒學校顧及學生需要
zh.dek: 九龍塘學校中學部被指開學日在校外排隊檢查校服，何文田鄧鏡波中學則有約300名學生因頭髮被指過長留校，教育局已聯絡兩校跟進。
body: 教育局表示，已就開學日儀容檢查安排聯絡兩所學校跟進，並提醒校方執行校規時應顧及學生的實際需要。
社交平台流傳片段及照片顯示，九龍塘學校（中學部）周二新學年首日有大批學生在校門外排隊等候檢查校服及頭髮，當時一號戒備信號生效並有雨。校長韓瑂儀其後向家長發通告，指校方上周六已提醒將於周二檢查儀容，以便周四拍攝學生照片；當日較多學生較遲抵達，因而需在校外排隊。她表示當天上午8時後拍卡不會當遲到，並已檢討執行細節。
另外，有讀者向傳媒反映，何文田鄧鏡波中學約300名學生因頭髮被指過長留校近一小時，並須逐一通知家長後才可離開。
教育局發言人表示，局方一直就制訂及執行校規提供一般原則指引，已即時聯絡有關學校了解及跟進，並提醒學校在執行校規時亦應顧及學生實際需要，作出適切的校本安排。
